actions.busy: Another browser management change is still in progress. Wait for it to finish and try again.

page.title: Browser management
page.description: Monitor lifecycle, capacity, queues, and identity for Agent browser lanes. Routine browsing stays headless until you explicitly open a running Primary lane.
page.capabilityUnavailable: Browser management is not available in this runtime.
page.empty: No managed browser resources are running. Routine Browser search starts silently in headless mode when needed.
page.residualResources: No browser lane is attached, but {{hosts}} managed Host(s) and {{cleanups}} pending cleanup(s) still exist. Use Close all to terminate them and confirm that every managed resource reached zero.
page.residualResourcesUser: No browser lane is attached, but {{hosts}} managed Host(s) and {{cleanups}} cleanup(s) belonging to you are still pending. The lifecycle worker will continue retrying; an installation owner can use Close all if cleanup does not finish.
page.selectLane: Select a browser lane to inspect it.

close.laneSuccess: Browser lane closed. The conversation and execution remain available.
close.laneActiveTitle: Close a browser lane with active work?
close.laneActiveContent: This cancels the lane's queued and active browser work. The conversation and Agent execution remain alive.
close.conversationTitle: Close all browser lanes for this conversation?
close.conversationContent: {{count}} browser lanes will be closed and active browser operations will be cancelled. The conversation and executions remain alive.
close.conversationContent_one: {{count}} browser lane will be closed and its active browser operations will be cancelled. The conversation and execution remain alive.
close.conversationContent_other: {{count}} browser lanes will be closed and active browser operations will be cancelled. The conversation and executions remain alive.
close.allContent: Every queued and running browser lane will be closed, pending cleanup will be drained, and managed Browser Hosts/processes will be terminated. Conversations and Agent executions remain alive. Success is reported only after the authoritative remaining counts for lanes, pending cleanup, and managed Hosts are all zero.
close.allSuccess: All managed browser resources are confirmed at zero: lanes, pending cleanup, and managed Hosts/processes.
close.partialFailure: Some browser lanes could not be closed.
close.partialFailureWithDetails: Some browser lanes could not be closed: {{details}}
close.refreshFailed: The close request finished, but the browser inventory could not be refreshed: {{error}}
close.unconfirmed: The browser manager did not confirm the close. Review the inventory and try again.
close.drainUnconfirmed: Close all was not confirmed: the authoritative remaining counts for lanes, pending cleanup, and managed Hosts are not all zero. Review the inventory and try again.

foreground.unavailable: Only a running Primary lane can be opened in the foreground.
foreground.refreshFailed: The browser was opened, but the browser inventory could not be refreshed: {{error}}
foreground.unconfirmed: The browser manager did not confirm that the lane opened in the foreground. Review its status and try again.

background.success: Browser returned to silent headless mode.
background.refreshFailed: The browser returned to headless mode, but the browser inventory could not be refreshed: {{error}}
background.unconfirmed: The browser manager did not confirm that the lane returned to silent headless mode. Review its status and try again.

displayMode.title: Global browser visibility default
displayMode.description: Routine Browser search and knowledge lookup use silent headless Chromium by default. Choose a visible window only when you want every Primary browser launch to appear; this policy is applied immediately and can be changed here.
displayMode.unavailable: The live browser visibility policy API is unavailable. The displayed fallback is read-only and no change has been claimed.
displayMode.errorWithDetails: The live browser visibility policy could not be loaded: {{error}}
displayMode.saved: Global browser visibility updated and applied.
displayMode.saveFailed: The browser visibility preference was not confirmed as saved: {{error}}
displayMode.refreshFailed: The visibility policy was applied, but the browser inventory could not be refreshed: {{error}}
displayMode.unconfirmed: The browser manager did not confirm the requested visibility policy.

details.backgroundExecution: Routine Agent browsing runs silently with no visible window by default. Use the visibility control to open a running Primary lane in the foreground or return it to silent headless mode. Page input remains Agent-controlled.
details.errorRecoverable: Recoverable. The browser manager may retry this lane.
details.errorTerminal: Not recoverable. Close this lane after reviewing the error.
details.restartedNotice: The managed browser restarted and the lane recovered automatically. No action is needed.

sections.currentDescription: Read-only lifecycle and active-page metadata from the browser manager.
sections.identityOwnerDescription: The identity domain and Agent execution that own this lane.
sections.queueResourcesDescription: Capacity scheduling, retry timing, and the lane resource estimate.

diagnostics.title: Host diagnostics
diagnostics.noHosts: No active Browser Hosts are currently reporting diagnostics.
